tasks.label: Odoo: init database (install all school modules)
tasks.command: docker compose stop odoo && docker compose run --rm odoo -d school_erp -i school_core,school_academic,school_security,school_student,school_admission,school_teacher,school_timetable,school_attendance,school_exam,school_fees,school_accounting,school_library,school_transport,school_communication,school_parent_portal,school_student_portal --with-demo --stop-after-init && docker compose start odoo

tasks.label: Odoo: update school modules
tasks.command: docker compose stop odoo && docker compose run --rm odoo -d school_erp -u school_core,school_academic,school_security,school_student,school_admission,school_teacher,school_timetable,school_attendance,school_exam,school_fees,school_accounting,school_library,school_transport,school_communication,school_parent_portal,school_student_portal --stop-after-init && docker compose start odoo

tasks.label: Odoo: install custom accounting pack
tasks.command: docker compose stop odoo && docker compose run --rm odoo -d school_erp -i om_account_accountant,web_responsive,om_print_journal_entry --stop-after-init && docker compose start odoo

tasks.label: Odoo: update custom accounting pack
tasks.command: docker compose stop odoo && docker compose run --rm odoo -d school_erp -u om_account_accountant,web_responsive,om_print_journal_entry --stop-after-init && docker compose start odoo

tasks.label: PostgreSQL: psql (school_erp)
tasks.command: docker compose exec db psql -U odoo -d school_erp
